input: deck is a list of n integer labels in [-9007199254740991,9007199254740991], with 0 <= n <=10000. Integer inputs are plain int, excluding bool; list and string inputs are ordinary list/str values without subclasses. No concurrent mutation or modified standard built-ins are allowed. Preconditions are not checked at runtime. Size bounds do not guarantee available memory or completion within an unqualified runtime budget.
return: Boolean indicating whether the entire nonempty deck can be partitioned into equal-sized groups of one identical value per group, with one common integer group size X >=2. X need not be returned. Empty input is explicitly false.
mutation_aliasing: All input values, caller containers and ordering remain unchanged. The Solution instance retains no state and separate calls share no mutable result state. A private frequency map is allocated. No cards are moved, removed or grouped in the input.
numeric: Label values are only hashed/compared. Counts and Euclidean remainders are nonnegative integers <=10000. The gcd helper checks right!=0 before modulo, so no zero divisor occurs. Starting gcd 0 adopts the first positive frequency.
complexity: O(n+u*log(n+1)+1) time for u distinct values under average map costs, O(u+1) map storage and O(1) helper state. A frequency gcd of1 permits immediate rejection. Map/set operation costs assume ordinary average O(1) lookup; target-runtime behavior must be qualified, and universal ECMAScript constant-time guarantees or adversarial collision resistance are not claimed.

helpers.name: greatest_common_divisor
helpers.contract: Euclidean gcd of nonnegative integer arguments, returning the first argument when the second is zero. Called with current common gcd and a positive frequency.
